attributes.probed_form: TWO edits inside `_value_equality_transfer` in tools/gdl/webfrank.py and nothing else -- the relation, its invariant, the copy closure, the constant closure, the declaration discipline and every other guard are untouched. (1) `zero_involved = (zero_1 or zero_2) and 0 in (cur_1, cur_2, tgt_1, tgt_2)` becomes `zero_involved = ((zero_1 and 0 in (cur_1, tgt_1)) or (zero_2 and 0 in (cur_2, tgt_2)))`. (2) a `remap_zero_none = {first: zero_2, second: zero_1}` is carried beside `remap` and applied as `zero_none = remap_zero_none.get(shift, zero_none)` before the RA|0 presence test, so the flag follows the field the expected value came FROM. Rule change: config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json's game/pb/pb_texture::fn_800C72DC entry drops `unproven_recolor_audit` and gains `value_equality_recolor: {substitutions: [], compare_exchanges: []}` plus the mechanism prose. The declaration is a NON-EMPTY object deliberately: tools/gdl/composed_census/wc_control_check.py selects its regression set with `if not rule.get('value_equality_recolor'): continue`, so an empty `{}` would have been valid to apply_patch (which tests `is not None`) while silently escaping the regression gate.

attributes.verification: TWO-SIDED CALIBRATION, both halves counted and reported. POSITIVE side: the image-wide census over 2845 paired functions finds exactly ONE payoff row, this one. NEGATIVE side: of the 101 fully screened rows, 89 are already proved by an earlier column and NONE of them moves its verdict or its declaration counts under the refinement, and 11 remain proved by no column -- including two rows, game/enemy/critter::CritterLoadDone at +0x98 and CritterLoadStartNext at +0xe0, that still refuse with `base register presence differs (g3 vs g0)`. Those two are the LIVE negative control the proposal asked for: a genuine RA|0 site where one side really does encode 'no base register' still fails closed, measured on the corpus rather than only in a fixture. REGRESSION GATE: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wc_control_check.py` -> `value-equality rules checked: 9; controls failed: 0` (8 before this rule joined the set, all held). REFUSAL TESTS SHOWN TO FAIL WITHOUT THEIR GUARD, per the two-sided rule -- `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wp_guard_two_sided.py` (promoted this run, commit 617f8ab7f) runs FIVE bodies against the shipped transfer and against one variant per deleted guard (NO_ZERO, NO_GATE, DEST_KEY) and prints: the payoff body PROVED/SHIPPED and REFUSED/DEST_KEY; the gate body (our RB is GPR0 against a target with no base register) REFUSED/SHIPPED and PROVED/NO_GATE, which is the gate catching a genuine unsoundness since the two are equal only if GPR0 happens to hold zero; the flag-travel body REFUSED/SHIPPED and PROVED/NO_ZERO. MEASURED AND CORRECTED: only TWO of the five bodies flip. The two `RA=0 on one side` bodies read REFUSED under EVERY variant, because with the RA|0 presence test deleted the value-equality relation check refuses them anyway -- an earlier draft of the test docstring claimed 'delete that test and both bodies prove' and that claim was FALSE. The shipped docstring and the tool's own legend now say which rows are load-bearing guard tests and which are redundant negative controls. FULL REPLAY, the gate an edit to webfrank.py owes: `touch tools/gdl/webfrank.py` then full `ninja -j2` twice -- 52 rule-carrying units replayed, `WEBFRANK fn_800C72DC: value-equality recolor proved (0 substitution(s), 0 comparison exchange(s))`, `build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK`. `python tools/gdl/fndiff.py game/pb/pb_texture fn_800C72DC --clean` -> `== fn_800C72DC: EXACT, 0 real diff lines`. `defake_gate.py baseline game/pb/pb_texture --at-head` anchored to commit 24bfa0c5a source sha1 9d1ad1b96 (19 functions, 17 at real 0), then `check` -> `GATE OK`. Both suites green after the change: `python -m unittest discover tools/gdl/tests -b` Ran 1327 tests OK (1321 before; the 6 new tests are CommutativeExchangeZeroFieldTests), `python -m memory_graph.test_graph --changed -b` Ran 359 tests OK. SCORES: unchanged by design -- STRICT 56.66% (2581 fns), EQUIVALENT 11.05% (152 fns), All 67.71%, fuzzy 98.51%. fn_800C72DC was ALREADY byte-equal via its unproven pin; what moved is the PROOF, not the bytes.
